sermon.title: Difference Between Conservatives and Followers of Jesus and The Bible
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In this session of “Clarity on Crucial Choices,” Pastor David G. Kincer compares the conservative and moderate platforms in America with what it means to be a believer, follower and Christian. He tests their positions against Scripture on abortion, sexual immorality, alcohol and drugs, legislating morals and the role of government, and says self-control is the way to go and followers of Jesus must not be Christians or conservatives in name only.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: This is a radio-style session titled “Clarity on Crucial Choices.” Some references are spoken as run-together numbers in the captions and were written out: “2 Chronicles 192” as 2 Chronicles 19:2, “1st Samuel 818” as 1 Samuel 8:18, “1 Timothy 5 8” as 1 Timothy 5:8. At 12:44 the name of the man the prophet speaks to in 2 Kings 8:12 was not clear in the captions (the passage names Hazael). Some passages are quoted without naming the reference (e.g. Judges 20, 1 John 2:12); the linked references are the passages he refers to. Statistics, percentages and political claims are given as spoken and have not been checked.

faqs.question: Is the phrase “separation of church and state” in the Constitution?
faqs.answer: He says conservatives are right that the phrase is not in the Constitution, and that government should never interfere with religious freedom.

faqs.question: Where are real Christians on the political spectrum?
faqs.answer: He says the real Christians are to the right of the Tea Party, but still believe in government with liberty and in free enterprise.

faqs.question: What does the word “Christian” mean?
faqs.answer: He says the suffix means to belong to, come from, be involved with or be like, so Christians belong to Christ, come from Christ, are involved with Christ and are like Christ.

faqs.question: Is believing in Jesus enough to make you his disciple?
faqs.answer: From John 8:31 he says belief is not truth, freedom or discipleship; following the word is following truth, makes you a disciple, and you find freedom.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Then Jesus said to those Jews who believed Him, “If you abide in My word, you are My disciples indeed. And you shall know the truth, and the truth shall make you free.”

faqs.question: What does he repeatedly say is “the way to go”?
faqs.answer: After each test he says self-control is the way to go.

faqs.question: Does the Bible approve of slavery?
faqs.answer: He says “no way”: First Timothy 1 says the law was made for men stealers, people who put people in slavery, to keep them from doing it.
